business_summary.text: Renaissance Global is transforming from a traditional jewellery manufacturer into a global, high-margin branded jewellery platform with a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands including Jean Dousset, WithClarity, and Enchanted Disney Fine Jewelry.

call_points.text: WithClarity revenue run rate is ₹220 Cr with 20% YoY growth, targeting 12-13% EBITDA margin
Licensed brands segment to be refocused on Disney, aiming to restore margins to 14-15%
Targeting ₹300 Cr+ operating cash flow in FY27 from working capital reduction

corporate_actions.subject: Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Rs 2/- Per Share

auditor_history.name: Chaturvedi & Shah LLP
auditor_history.note: Audit report on standalone and consolidated results carries an unmodified opinion; other-matter paragraphs cover subsidiaries audited by other auditors and one unaudited immaterial subsidiary.

guidance.statement: We expect strong growth in profitability in the coming year in the range of 20% to 30%, supported by our increasing contribution from our direct-to-consumer segment and improving efficiencies.
Based on current momentum and market tailwinds, we expect our U.S. direct-to-consumer revenues to organically grow between 35% to 40% this year to INR375 crores by end of FY27.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: Clarified that import duty revisions on gold, silver, and platinum do not impact operations due to SEEPZ SEZ exemptions and negligible domestic sales.
FY26 foreign exchange loss was ₹31.47 Cr against ₹7.56 Cr in FY25, with ₹9.24 Cr in Q4FY26 alone.
Purchases of stock-in-trade rose to ₹1,380 Cr in FY26 from ₹494 Cr, while cost of materials consumed fell 38.5% to ₹612 Cr.
Total ordinary equity shares outstanding were 10,73,25,471 as on March 31, 2026, after ESOP exercises.
Each existing Jean Dousset store generates between ₹30 Cr and ₹35 Cr in annual sales with ₹8-10 Cr bottom-line contribution.
Jean Dousset has 3 operational stores with plans to add 4 more in FY27, targeting a total of 7 stores by end of FY27 and 6 more in FY28.
WithClarity has a revenue run rate of ₹220 Cr with 20% YoY growth and gross margins of 60-65%.
The company is exiting B2B businesses with high working capital intensity, expecting a revenue reduction of ₹300-400 Cr in FY27.

timeline.summary: Renaissance Global clarified that the revision in import duty on precious metals has no material impact on its operations due to its SEZ status.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹773.41 Cr (+50.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹32.31 Cr (+29.0% YoY).
Renaissance Global Limited’s Q4 FY 2026 earnings conference call held on May 29, 2026, with audio recording available on the company’s website.
Renaissance Global hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 29, 2026, guiding for 20-30% profit growth in FY27.
Renaissance Global held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 10, 2026, reporting strong revenue and profit growth and outlining its strategic focus on D2C brands and working capital optimization.

watchlist.text: Foreign exchange loss as share of revenue

watchlist.response: Management stated they focus on running the business efficiently and growing earnings, and the market will eventually realize the true potential.
watchlist.text: Share price underperformance despite profit growth

watchlist.response: Darshil Shah stated the loss is due to currency appreciation and that a large part of working capital is dollar-denominated, providing a natural hedge. He expects a meaningful reduction if the currency stabilizes.
watchlist.text: Forex loss of ₹13 Cr in Q1FY27, with questions on future reduction

watchlist.response: Sumit Shah attributed the dip to strategic exits of low-margin businesses and minor exit costs, stating margins are comparable on a like-for-like basis.
watchlist.text: Reduction in consolidated margins from 7.7% to 7.2% YoY
